message.content:
A medium‑sized apple (about 182 g) typically contains around **95 calories**.  
If you’re looking at a range:

| Size | Weight (g) | Calories |
|------|------------|----------|
| Small | ~149 | ~77 |
| Medium | ~182 | ~95 |
| Large | ~223 | ~116 |

These numbers are averages from the USDA database. The exact calorie count can vary slightly depending on the apple variety, ripeness, and whether it’s eaten with or without the skin.
